population.out: drag-LEO, active, altimetry, ISS, Starlink, GPS, GLONASS-K1, Sentinel-1D, TerraSAR-X, COSMIC-2

sets.historyRule: cutoffs in (E - 90 d, E - 3 d]; run sealed after the freeze

ilrsa.stub: 260926 (307-308 B): reissue sought, else the cutoffs 09-20 and 09-27 are lost

independentTruth.report: every cell against GFZ rapid orbits beside ESA next file, per class, axis and lead; scored once, at the same time and the same way
independentTruth.verdict: no change; adds no cell and no rule
independentTruth.wording: A pass against ESA's next-day file with any R3 GNSS cell out of band against GFZ is reported as exactly that, in the same sentence as the verdict.
independentTruth.route: GFZ0OPSRAP from https://isdc-data.gfz.de/gnss/products/rapid/w<week>/, no credentials; checked before the freeze

arcDisjoint: fit track = the last 24 h of the latest arc ending (t_in) by the cutoff; leads run from t_in; truth and references only from arcs starting at or after t_in, excluding the fit's own arc

fit.common: C2's: fit_batch version 3, one round, sigma 10 m per axis, GCRF, track at 600 s, RK78, relative tolerance 1e-10, steps up to 120 s

model.formula: P_w(L) = D_o g_w(L) P_C2(L) D_o + C_w
model.stopIf: the validation interval of C3-ab minus C3-0 is below 0

storm.rule: [E - 24 h, E + L) meets a UTC day with GFZ Ap >= 30
storm.effect: out of primary cells, into a stratum

notices.rule: any notice naming the satellite, except return-to-service, over its stated interval (open: to the next return-to-service), overlapping [E - 24 h, E + 84 h], issued by the scoring date (by E in history)

exclusions.weatherGap: validation windows that hit B1's dropped day 2026-05-09 are refused and counted; no fill; a fresh window refused for missing weather is uncovered

earthOrientation.rule: measured, never predicted, in every window
earthOrientation.calVal: C2's file (hac/iers-eop/20261009, B1's environment; the reference states as C2 converted them)
earthOrientation.later: the first archived file whose values are flagged measured through E + 84 h; named in the window's row; the window waits for that file
earthOrientation.reportOnly: UT1 as issued minus measured, median and p95 per lead, in meters at each R3 class's radius, beside C2's along-track sigma per lead; no FFM run

eligible.nEff: (2/3)/Var(cell mean d2/3) under P7's heavy-tail arm, on realized counts

judgedIf.otherwise: one month once (R3 to 2026-12-31), else reported

q6.question: must each direction pass too?
q6.a: the band decides, per-axis reported, |mean z| > 0.5 labeled biased
q6.b: a cell counts only with band and all axes in range, and every eligible per-axis interval overlaps
q6.rule: Q6 is the owner's. A yes by 2026-11-09 23:59 UTC -> (b). A no, or no answer by then -> (a). The answer is recorded in a dated commit, whether or not the freeze commit has landed, and before any fresh file is scored.

p4.eligible: stored windows of population.calVal with a converged fit and stored terms

limits.termination: a class fit may change only to CONVERGED
limits.gem: pair_statistics, noise_responses, dcp_covariance bit-identical on 0.11.0 and 0.10.0 on the same inputs

p4.onFailure: stop and ask; the limits do not move

p1Esa.statistic: p95 boundary jump / sqrt(2) / C2's forecast sigma, whole population, per axis
p1Esa.cellLabel: GNSS 1, 6 and 12 h: truth is the next daily file, which may share tracking data with the fit's

p1b.rule: r_low = A / B, r_high = A / (B - C); per class, axis and lead; mean z^2 under C2's P; primary exclusions
p1b.keep: the 95 % paired interval of r_low at or above 0.90 at 1, 6 and 12 h, both classes, all axes
p1b.stop: r_high's interval wholly below 0.90 at any of those
p1b.otherwise: stop and ask, with the table
p1b.order: calibration windows, lowest SHA-256 of C3S|p1|<norad>|<E>, one round across every satellite at a time

bootstrap.over: satellites and windows, one resample for A, B and C

poolAdded.use: this check only: no fit, no verdict, no cell
poolAdded.missing: files or seeds missing: dropped and listed

nsgfArcs.rule: cal/val and history use the daily arcs in <store>/reference; P4 stays on C2's own arcs

pRefGfz.error: forecast minus GFZ at the lead epoch
pRefGfz.besideReportOnly: c plus the mean squared ESA minus GFZ difference over the history
